title: Two open-source ways to retire Gmail

intro.headline: Your email, minus the ads, trackers, and telemetry.
intro.subhead: Thunderbird and FairEmail are fully open-source mail clients that plug straight into the address you already own — no ads, no scanning, no lock-in.

outro.headline: Same inbox. None of the surveillance.
outro.subhead: Keep your address, keep your history, and stop paying for mail with your data. Which client are you trying first?
